notes.title: Patch Notes 9/27/18
notes.notes:
[b](Warning: Contains spoilers)[/b]
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]First death achievement now works as expected
[*][spoiler]Code that opens sphinx box is now much easier to see with flashlight at further distances[/spoiler]
[*]Few notes / lore have been moved from the [spoiler]starting area (Granny’s house) to the temple[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Note containing clue for projector puzzle has been moved to the dining room[/spoiler]
[*]“Find Valentina” achievement now unlocks for player when the [spoiler]shack door is open instead of examining Valentina[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Blue fairy no longer spawns after the Christmas section[/spoiler]
[*]Removed “Door is locked” message when player interacts with [spoiler]kitchen door at beginning before black tar covering is removed[/spoiler]
[*]Screen resolution no longer changes to default when player dies or restarts game
[*]Changes to improve controller performance including resolving a bug that prevented the player from selecting items in the inventory, to decreasing sensitivity by 25%
[*]Pot in front yard porch was removed as it [spoiler]mimicked pot in greenhouse[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed a few spelling errors in different notes, tooltips and other narrative text elements
[*]Tips delay reduced so player receives hint(s) sooner
[*]Double latch on attic hatch has been removed in the [spoiler]Christmas section[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a few new tool tips to help with late game player progression & help with boss fight(s)
[*][spoiler]Final boss has had a small dmg and move speed increase[/spoiler]
[*]Tooltips added when [spoiler]swords are placed[/spoiler]. This was done to help with player progression and to give the player a better understanding of the action that takes place once the [spoiler]sword(s) has been placed[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Blue Fairy enemy AI[/spoiler] has had some small tweaks to improve performance as well as balancing
[*][spoiler]Additional save point has been added to the underground temple[/spoiler]
[*]Alex now runs faster while holding the flashlight
[*]Enemies will no longer move when player is in the glyph menu or inventory
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Issue resolved in starting room where player could get stuck on bottom of bed if they interacted with a specific point
[*]Issue resolved where player could get stuck on skeleton. This skeleton was located to the left after you enter the [spoiler]main temple room[/spoiler]
[*]Button prompt issue on [spoiler]column puzzles in temple[/spoiler] has been resolved
[*]Issue resolved where game was freezing if player picked up glyph from too far away
[*]Issue resolved where players could open same sphinx stash more than once if they left the area then returned
[*]Issue resolved where two sphinx stashes were giving same reward. They now have their own unique reward for solving
[*]Issue resolved where player could place items not related to the puzzle into the [spoiler]teddy cage in Christmas section[/spoiler], losing them forever. This is no longer possible
[*]Various audio fixes implemented
[/list]
